Max Brooks warned on HBO's Real Time that the Democratic coalition's sole focus on opposing Donald Trump risks bringing in toxic elements.

The Bright Side:
Opens a candid internal debate about the future direction of progressive coalitions beyond single-figure opposition.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing tactical coalition breadth (WHO) with ideological purity (WHAT), distorting party dynamics for media punch.

Social Physics Analysis:
Actors deploy a projected threat narrative to rally factions while avoiding structural introspection. This mirrors a defensive maneuver that frames internal disagreement as existential contamination.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated strategic warnings and actual polarizing framing, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. F_pos outweighs F_neg via targeted amplification.

The Unavoidable Truth: Broad coalitions require shared foundational values beyond opposing a single leader.

The Unavoidable Lie: Disparate political allies represent an existential communist plot.
